# Agatha Sowerby

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c9 P0](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0000), [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031)</sub>
- **Status:** widowed  <sub>[v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P3](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0003)</sub>
- **Origin:** St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v2 c1 P48](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0048)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mrs.  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby is a stout woman whose walk is described as a perpetual waddle. In her later years, her hands are coarsened by labor.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031), [v2 c26 P1](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0001)_

## Personality

Agatha Sowerby is an energetic, highly opinionated, and candid woman who takes pride in freely voicing her thoughts without partiality. Vigilant and extremely inquisitive, she pays strict attention to the affairs of her neighbors and maintains a close watch over everything passing by her home. She is a sharp, capable homemaker and church leader who holds firm, conservative views and strongly values proper decorum, order, and traditional doctrine. Though often perceived as a intrusive busybody, she possesses good intentions, a kind heart, and acts as a devoted wife and devoted community worker.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P24](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0024), [v1 c9 P0](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0000), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P1](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0001), [v1 c21 P5](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0005), [v1 c31 P4](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0004), [v1 c31 P7](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0007), [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P48](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0048), [v2 c1 P50](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0050), [v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 c9 P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P1](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0001)_

## History

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby resided for decades in Sowerby's Hollow in Brierley, serving as a pillar of community organizations including the Sewing Circle, Sunday-school, Church Aid Society, and Foreign Missions Auxiliary. When Obed and Thirza Abernethy unexpectedly brought home an orphan girl named Nell, Agatha immediately investigated and voiced strong misgivings. After making blunt comments about Nell's freckles and red hair that caused a dramatic outburst, Nell was forced by Thirza to deliver a grand apology, which Agatha accepted warmly, offering the girl flowers from her garden. Over the following years, Agatha actively involved herself in local matters, advising Thirza on raising Nell, evaluating incoming ministers, crafting stylish clothing for Nell, and attending a political rally in Port Marlow. Following a period where her husband Thomas's health declined, he passed away. Due to debts and mortgages incurred on their farm, Agatha faced the loss of her home and potential departure from Brierley; however, her longtime neighbor Thirza invited her to move into Grey Shutters, setting up the former spare room into a private kitchen for her.
